wrote the date on a thing so I'd remember when.
restrung it and immediately put it down again.
had two things going and neither went anywhere that month.

reorganised the shelf by colour. took an hour.
past about three separate things on the go I stop treating each on its own terms and start bringing solutions across from the others.
no. I catch myself having already done it.

cleaned everything instead of using any of it.
found a half-finished thing at the back of a drawer.
wrote down an idea and closed the notebook.
spent a month on one thing exclusively and got it solid.
spent the evening reading about it rather than doing it.
fixed the wobbly leg on the table finally.
listened back to something from last year and winced.
every idea of mine anyone has ever called original turned out to be something carried over from whatever else I had going at the time. the single-minded stretches produced correct, unremarkable work.
lent something out and immediately wanted it back.
sorted the offcuts into a box. a whole box.
